# Legacy game fixtures

Synthetic records for byte-decoding and format tests; these are not historical games.

- `tygem-korean.gib`: EUC-KR, three Tygem handicap stones.
- `tygem-chinese.gib`: GB18030, even game.
- `wbaduk-japanese.ngf`: Shift-JIS, two handicap stones, zero komi, and a pass.

Format fields were checked against [PySGF](https://github.com/sanderland/pysgf/blob/main/pysgf/parser.py) and [Sabaki](https://github.com/SabakiHQ/Sabaki/tree/master/src/modules/fileformats).
